def test_HeadersFormatter_format_headers():

        "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n"
        "X-Zeta: last\r\n"

        "Set-Cookie: second=value\r\n"
        "Accept: */*"
    )

        "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n"
        "Accept: */*\r\n"
        "Content-Type: application/json\r\n"
        "Set-Cookie: first=value\r\n"
        "Set-Cookie: second=value\r\n"
        "X-Zeta: last"
    )
